structured_output.what_is_happening: Tweet-driven name launch: a Beff Jezos (e/acc) tweet linked from GeckoTerminal/GMGN seems to have set off a swarm of "Kardashev Research" copycat tokens on Solana. This token (6MuH…) is one of 10+ same-name clones. The project link in its own metadata points to a different token, 5wW9…, which is the largest one at about $1.8M mcap. This clone launched on a Meteora virtual curve and migrated to PumpSwap in the same second. It pumped about 175% in 25 minutes, then fell 47-51% in the last 5 minutes.

narrative.description: Beff Jezos / e/acc and the Kardashev scale. It is a real, well-known figure and meme theme, and the tweet itself could not be read (HTTP 402). Web search shows a live Solana KARDASHEV coin at about $2M.
narrative.why_spreading: A tweet by a prominent e/acc personality, and the ticker was sniped many times within about 2 hours

token_connection.why_this_token: None. This token's own website field links to the 5wW9… token page on usepaid.app, and 5wW9… is the earliest and largest of the clones.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 5wW9… ($1.82M mcap, earliest large one), 8Rz6… ($423k, $9.9M h1 vol), Gff9… ($8M h1 vol), 6SBi…, and several dead clones

authenticity.evidence: GeckoTerminal shows 2,125 unique buyers against only 95 unique sellers, and 6k buys, which looks like a bot or bundle spray. GMGN tags 51 bundler wallets. One top holder has 80% (not labeled as the pool), and the top 10 hold 85-95%. Launch and migration happened in the same second, and the image is duplicated 6 times.
authenticity.uncertainty: The 80% holder could be an unlabeled Meteora/Pump pool vault. GMGN's top10 rate of 5.5% conflicts with RugCheck's figure.

structural_risks: 99.99% of the LP is unlocked (RugCheck danger)
One wallet holds 80% of supply (possibly a pool, but unverified)
Clone of the canonical token, competing with bigger same-name pools
Already fell about 50% from the ATH in the last 5 minutes, which looks like a dump in progress

structured_output.counterargument: The narrative is real and hot, and volume is huge ($1.35M in 30 minutes on a $170k mcap). Clone tokens sometimes get second waves when the canonical coin runs. If the 80% holder is just the pool vault, the structure is less bad than it looks, and a bounce from -50% back to the ATH would already be about 2x.
